caption:
Holiday bed, not-so-holiday back? Koko woke up creaky on day one of her trip.

A softer or firmer mattress and an unfamiliar pillow change how your neck and back are supported, so a night or two of stiffness is common. It usually eases once you're up and moving.

Easy tweaks: pack your own pillow if your neck is fussy, pop a pillow between your knees on a soft bed, or a folded blanket under your hips on a firm one. Start the day with knee rocks and a short walk instead of lying in.

Pain that keeps building or numbness down an arm or leg is worth getting checked. Stiff once you're home? Our chiropractors at Hybrid Physio can help. Book online via the link in bio 🎄
